source_name: Министерство за информатичко општество и администрација (МИОА) — legacy site
why_relevant: Predecessor institution; still hosts historical e-government, open data and ENER documentation that explains the origin of current digital-payment and e-service infrastructure and past vendor engagements.

source_name: Архива на Министерство за финансии — стратешко планирање
why_relevant: Archive site holding older MoF strategic plans (2023-2025, 2024-2026, 2025-2027) that are no longer on the redesigned main site — needed for longitudinal tracking of digitalisation commitments.

source_name: uslugi.gov.mk — national e-services catalogue, Central Registry institution page
why_relevant: Authoritative enumeration of every CRM service, with fee and access conditions per service. Useful for planning what is legally obtainable and at what cost, and for detecting when a previously fee-based registry service becomes free/public.

source_name: Contracting-authority own procurement pages (Царинска управа, ЈП, министерства)
why_relevant: Many authorities mirror tender documentation as PDFs on their own sites, often with fuller technical specifications than the ESJN summary. Customs, Ministry of Economy, Ministry of Defence and utilities (Vodovod Skopje, EVN) all do this. Technical specs reveal incumbent vendor lock-in and product names for payment/IT systems.

source_name: Ministry of European Affairs / Secretariat for European Affairs — IFI and IPA funds pages (ЕБОР, Светска банка, друга странска помош)
why_relevant: MK government's own donor/IFI coordination pages map which institution finances what, with dedicated pages for EBRD (ЕБОР), the World Bank, and 'other foreign assistance' — an actor map and pointer layer into programme documents and the beneficiary institutions that will procure.

source_name: Ministry of European Affairs (MK) - Macedonian working translations of EC country reports
why_relevant: Hosts Macedonian-language working versions of the EC annual report; gives the authoritative MK terminology for EU financial-sector concepts (платежни услуги, финансиски услуги, дигитална трансформација) needed to build local-language query sets for other cells.

entity_name: National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia
source_name: NBRNM — Payment institutions, e-money institutions and payment system operators (hub page)
why_relevant: Hub linking all non-bank PSP registers and the licensing regime; snowballs into individual registers, sub-laws and operator lists.

entity_name: National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia
source_name: NBRSM — Листа на водечки броеви на банките (bank leading/BIC-style code list)
why_relevant: Canonical bank identifier list used in MIPS/KIBS routing. Low glamour but high value as the join key for reconciling entity names across registers, statistics and market data.

entity_name: National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia
source_name: NBRSM — Слободен пристап до информации од јавен карактер (FOI list of information)
why_relevant: Freedom-of-information catalogue enumerating what NBRSM holds and will release on request — a legal fallback route to register/oversight data that is not published in reusable form, and a map of unpublished datasets.

source_name: CompanyWall MK / zk.mk — company registry mirrors for КИБС АД and CaSys АД
why_relevant: Aggregators of Central Register data: legal names, EMBS/EDB identifiers, ownership, management and financial results for KIBS AD and Internacionalen Karticen Sistem AD — reveals shareholder structure (which banks own the rails) and financial scale without a paid registry subscription.

source_name: MASIT — ICT Chamber of Commerce member directory
why_relevant: Ready-made census of MK ICT vendors (~80+ members, paginated ~13 pages) with individual company profile pages — the primary vendor/competitor list for banking IT, payments integrators and software houses.

source_name: MASIT — Chamber of ICT, member directory (Здружение МАСИТ)
why_relevant: The MK ICT chamber publishes per-member profile pages (e.g. /members-mk/бцс/, /en/members-en/accent/) describing each company's services and sector focus. This is the canonical enumeration of the local integrator/software-house population from which the finance-serving subset can be filtered, and it is bilingual (mk /members-mk/, en /members-en/).

source_name: MASIT — ICT Chamber of Commerce member directory
why_relevant: Not a job board, but the authoritative roster of MK ICT companies (CaSys is a listed member) from which to build the employer watchlist that all the hiring monitors are then keyed on — the actor map that makes cell #11 systematic rather than opportunistic.

source_name: Здружение на финансиски организации — Economic Chamber of NM
why_relevant: Cross-sector association uniting banks, insurers, pension fund managers, non-banking financial companies, leasing firms and savings houses — the broadest single membership frame for the MK financial demand side.

source_name: Групација на небанкарски финансиски друштва — Economic Chamber of NM
why_relevant: Non-bank financial companies group: the fastest-moving fintech-adjacent segment (consumer lending, alternative finance) and a distinct buyer pool for payment and self-service technology.

source_name: Economic Chamber of North Macedonia — ICT Association member list (mchamber.mk)
why_relevant: The second, independent enumeration of MK ICT companies plus the named individuals representing them (e.g. Александар Пајковски of ДУНА, and Ултра among members). Useful for actor mapping and for identifying the executives who front vendor–bank relationships.

source_name: Асоцијација на осигурително-брокерски друштва — Economic Chamber of NM
why_relevant: Insurance-broker association (formed 2011) — adjacent buyer segment for digital onboarding/document and payment technology; useful for widening the addressable-actor map beyond banks.

source_name: AETM Register of e-merchants (Регистар на е-трговци)
why_relevant: Searchable list of MK e-merchants with integrated online card payment via one of the five acquiring banks — a direct proxy for who acquires whom in MK e-commerce.

source_name: Macedonian Stock Exchange (Македонска берза) — issuer pages
why_relevant: Per-issuer pages give the canonical legal name, ticker and links to filings for every listed bank — the authoritative actor map and the routing layer into SEINet documents.

source_name: eCommerce4all.mk — e-payment processing module (MK e-commerce association resource)
why_relevant: Neutral explainer of how MK online card processing works and who the acquirers/processors/gateways are — a compact pointer to the acquiring value chain from the merchant side, useful for enumerating gateway options per bank.

source_name: AmCham North Macedonia
why_relevant: Bilateral chamber whose membership includes banks, telcos and IT firms; committees and policy events surface digital-economy positions and introduce foreign vendors entering MK.

source_name: AmCham North Macedonia — member directory (CaSys, Asseco SEE, Diners Club)
why_relevant: Business-chamber directory that co-locates payments infrastructure actors and their tech suppliers with short company profiles; useful for snowballing the vendor set around the rails (e.g. Asseco SEE/Payten presence in MK) and for event/partnership signals.

source_name: AppsRunTheWorld - Asseco CBS customer database
why_relevant: Commercial analyst database that compiles core-banking-system customer lists from public and proprietary sources; a rare structured route to which banks (potentially incl. MK) run Asseco CBS, complementing archived vendor reference pages.

source_name: Zlatna Kniga / zk.mk — MK business directory, 'Електронско банкарство' category (Skopje)
why_relevant: Highest-yield pointer found in this cell: a Macedonian-language directory category that co-lists banks AND their technology suppliers. Fetched listing named АСЕЕ, Некстсенс, Мелон Солушнс, Ултра, Ентаер лоџик ДИТ, Западна Унија/УФС alongside Komercijalna, NLB, Stopanska, ProCredit, Halkbank, CKB, Uni Banka, TTK, Silk Road. Adjacent categories (Компјутерски софтвер - развој, Банкомати) extend the actor map.

source_name: Balkan Fintech Association — regional events and members
why_relevant: Regional umbrella body whose event listings and membership roster point to Balkan fintech gatherings and to which MK players are affiliated; a snowball hub for events not indexed under 'North Macedonia'.

source_name: EMIS (ISI Emerging Markets) - company profiles for MK banking-IT firms
why_relevant: Commercial emerging-markets aggregator carrying structured MK company profiles (legal entity, executives, partner list); the Asseco SEE DOOEL profile lists technology partnerships (IBM, EMC2, Fujitsu-Siemens, Wincor-Nixdorf). Useful for building the vendor actor map with registry-grade identifiers.

source_name: Foreign Investors Council (FIC) North Macedonia
why_relevant: ~40 foreign-capital companies incl. foreign-owned banks; publishes Business and Investment Indicator and holds quarterly government meetings — good for ownership-driven procurement signals and policy asks.

source_name: Mondaq — North Macedonia FinTech Comparative Guide (law firm chapters)
why_relevant: Law-firm authored jurisdiction guide describing licensing regimes, which activities require NBRNM vs Ministry of Finance authorisation, and constraints on non-bank entrants.

source_name: Seavus (Скопје) — customer stories, incl. FeaturedCustomers profile
why_relevant: Named seed actor. Skopje-rooted, Swedish-owned software house with an explicit banking/finance vertical (Erste Bank, Banca Intesa cited in profiles) and a Salesforce consulting-partner listing. Third-party aggregators (FeaturedCustomers, AppExchange) expose its case-study set and partner tier without relying on its own marketing site.

source_name: skopjehacklab/e-nabavki — open-source scraper for e-nabavki.gov.mk
why_relevant: Community project whose stated aim is to make e-nabavki machine friendly. Documents the dossier endpoint and its Id/Level parameters — a direct shortcut to a working collection method for the portal, and a pointer to other civic-tech actors who may hold historical dumps.

entity_name: TechBehemoths / The Manifest / Clutch-style MK IT company listings
source_name: TechBehemoths / The Manifest / Clutch-style MK IT company listings
why_relevant: English-language service-provider marketplaces enumerate MK IT companies with self-declared industry focus (financial services), team size and sometimes client names — a fast way to widen the integrator long-list and to see how MK firms position themselves to foreign buyers. Self-reported, so credibility is limited.

source_name: Thales CPL partner directory — NEXTSENSE D.O.O. partner profile
why_relevant: Vendor partner directories expose the supply chain behind MK deployments (here: Thales cryptography/HSM/identity delivered through a Skopje integrator). Partner-locator pages are a reliable, under-used pointer to who implements what locally.

source_name: TheBanks.eu — North Macedonia bank profiles
why_relevant: Compact English-language directory of MK banks with ownership and profile pages; useful for cross-checking legal names, owners and English transliterations when building the actor map and de-duplicating aliases.

source_name: UNODC GlobE Network — Directory of Open-Source Registries: North Macedonia
why_relevant: Curated inventory of MK official registries (company, beneficial ownership, and adjacent registers) with access notes. Fast way to enumerate registry-type sources beyond CRM that this cell should cover, maintained by an institutional actor rather than a marketing site.

source_name: Wikipedia (mk) — Македонски Интербанкарски Платен Систем
why_relevant: Low-credibility but high-yield pointer: consolidates MIPS history, participant categories, SWIFT-standard operation and cut-off times, with citations back to NBRNM — a fast orientation and citation-harvesting layer when nbrm.mk blocks automated access.

source_name: АЦИ Македонија — Здружение на финансиски пазари (ACI Macedonia)
why_relevant: Financial-markets professionals association (treasury/dealing community across MK banks) — membership and events map treasury and markets-technology stakeholders.

source_name: Огледало на Владата (Government Mirror) — ENER monitoring reports
why_relevant: Civil-society watchdog producing monthly/quarterly reports on ENER compliance and a curated directory of state institutions and portals — an efficient snowball map of government sources and a check on what government failed to publish.

source_name: Слободен пристап (slobodenpristap.mk) — FOI request platform
why_relevant: Public FOI-request platform listing bodies (including ДКЖЈН and procurement authorities) and publishing responses. A legal fallback route to obtain award documents or contract annexes that are not posted, and an archive of already-answered requests.

entity_name: Сојуз на стопански комори на Македонија
source_name: Сојуз на стопански комори на Македонија (Union of Chambers of Commerce)
why_relevant: Third chamber body; separate membership and sector groupings, useful to triangulate actor lists and catch firms absent from mchamber.mk and MASIT.

source_name: Стопанска комора на северозападна Македонија (Chamber of Commerce of NW Macedonia)
why_relevant: Second major chamber (Albanian-language business community, Tetovo/Skopje) with its own member base and events — needed for full ecosystem coverage; also publishes in Albanian, a language outside this run's declared set.
